parameters.query:
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name AS referencia,
    p.title AS titulo,
    p.price AS precio,
    p.area AS metros_cuadrados,
    p.bedrooms AS habitaciones,
    p.bathrooms AS banos,
    p.parking_spaces AS parqueaderos,
    p.street AS direccion_zona,
    p.city AS ciudad,
    COALESCE(t.name, 'Propiedad') AS tipo_propiedad,
    CASE p.offer_type WHEN 'sale' THEN 'Venta' ELSE 'Arriendo' END AS oferta,
    CASE
        WHEN p.wp_post_id IS NOT NULL AND p.wp_post_id > 0 THEN 'https://inmobi.com.ec/?p=' || p.wp_post_id
        ELSE NULL
    END AS link_propiedad,
    p.wp_post_id,
    p.property_score AS puntuacion,
    (
        (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) * 10
         FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.ubicacion_norm || "" }}', ' ')) w
         WHERE length(w) >= 3
           AND lower(translate(COALESCE(p.title,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
               ILIKE '%' || lower(translate(w,'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) || '%')
        + (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) * 7
           FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.ubicacion_norm || "" }}', ' ')) w
           WHERE length(w) >= 3
             AND lower(translate(COALESCE(p.sector_keywords,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
                 ILIKE '%' || lower(translate(w,'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) || '%')
        + (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) * 5
           FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.ubicacion_norm || "" }}', ' ')) w
           WHERE length(w) >= 3
             AND lower(translate(COALESCE(p.city,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
                 ILIKE '%' || lower(translate(w,'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) || '%')
        + (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) * 5
           FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.busqueda_libre_norm || "" }}', ' ')) w
           WHERE length(w) >= 3
             AND lower(translate(COALESCE(p.title,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.description,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.sector_keywords,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
                 ILIKE '%' || lower(translate(w,'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) || '%')
        + CASE WHEN p.price <= {{ $json.presupuesto_max || 999999999 }} THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.bedrooms,0) >= {{ $json.habitaciones_min || 0 }} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS relevancia
FROM estate_property p
LEFT JOIN estate_property_type t ON p.property_type_id = t.id
WHERE p.state = 'available'
  AND p.active = true
  AND p.price > 0
  AND p.price <= ({{ $json.presupuesto_max || 999999999 }} * 1.15)
  AND (
    '{{ $json.tipo_propiedad_norm || "" }}' = ''
    OR lower(translate(COALESCE(t.name,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
       ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.tipo_propiedad_norm || "" }}' || '%'
  )
  AND (
    '{{ $json.tipo_oferta || "" }}' = ''
    OR p.offer_type = '{{ $json.tipo_oferta }}'
  )
  AND COALESCE(p.bedrooms, 0)       >= {{ $json.habitaciones_min || 0 }}
  AND COALESCE(p.bathrooms, 0)      >= {{ $json.banos_min || 0 }}
  AND COALESCE(p.parking_spaces, 0) >= {{ $json.parqueaderos_min || 0 }}
  AND (
    '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm || "" }}' = ''
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}', ' ')) w
      WHERE length(w) >= 3
        AND lower(translate(
              COALESCE(p.title,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.street,'') || ' ' ||
              COALESCE(p.city,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.sector_keywords,''),
              'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
            ILIKE '%' || lower(translate(w,'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) || '%'
    )
  )
  AND (
    '{{ $json.busqueda_libre_norm || "" }}' = ''
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.busqueda_libre_norm }}', ' ')) w
      WHERE length(w) >= 3
        AND lower(translate(
              COALESCE(p.title,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.description,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.sector_keywords,''),
              'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN'))
            ILIKE '%' || lower(translate(w,'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) || '%'
    )
  )
ORDER BY relevancia DESC, p.property_score DESC NULLS LAST, p.price ASC
LIMIT 8;
